name: Lip scrub exfoliation

lead: A lip scrub rubs flaking skin off the lips so they look smoother and take balm or lipstick more evenly. The smoothing is visible right away.

Sugar or salt grains physically remove surface skin cells, which is a form of mechanical exfoliation. No studies of lip scrubs specifically were found. Dermatologists quoted on Wikipedia say exfoliation is not medically necessary because skin sheds on its own, and that lip licking and weather are common causes of chapping.

paras: People rub the scrub gently over the lips, rinse or wipe it off, and follow with balm or petroleum jelly. It is commonly done before applying lip color, and some do it once or twice a week.
Dermatologists quoted on Wikipedia say over-exfoliating can weaken the skin barrier and cause redness and sensitivity. Rough scrubbing on already cracked lips can cause irritation.

chain: Smoother lips that hold color better
angle.text: Users rub on sugar or salt scrubs to clear flaking skin so lips look smoother and take balm or color more evenly. The smoothing is visible right away. No studies test lip scrubs specifically.

lead: A lip scrub is an abrasive product, commonly sugar- or salt-based, used to rub flaking skin off the lips. It is a form of mechanical exfoliation, in which abrasives such as sugar or salt crystals, cloths or brushes physically remove surface skin cells [1].

Dermatologists quoted on Wikipedia say manual or chemical exfoliation is not medically necessary because skin sheds dead cells on its own, and that overdoing it can weaken the skin barrier and cause sensitivity and redness [1]. Wikipedia's article on cheilitis lists lip licking and weather as common causes of chapped lips and describes barrier lubricants such as lip balm or petroleum jelly as the usual treatment [2]. No looksmaxxing-community sources or studies of lip scrubs were found.

paras: Over-exfoliation of skin is described as capable of impairing the barrier and increasing tightness and redness [1]. In exfoliative cheilitis, a rare condition with scaling lips, a link to lip picking or licking habits has been reported [2].
